integrity.diagonal_stratification_basis: Exact equality patterns of diagonal entries are indexed by set partitions, and each block-count stratum is a configuration-space quotient.
integrity.first_public_date_basis: The arXiv record for 1206.2358 gives first submission date 2012-06-11.
integrity.fixed_locus_basis: Generic diagonal conjugation fixes the full diagonal projective space and isolated off-diagonal matrix-unit points.
integrity.localization_basis: Compactly supported Euler characteristic localizes to the fixed locus for algebraic one-dimensional torus actions; projectivity gives ordinary Euler characteristic.
integrity.object_basis: The archival full text defines the Zariski-closed complex matrix variety of matrices with a bounded number of distinct eigenvalues.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: The archival source lists 14P05 among its Primary MSC classifications, together with 13F20 and 15A72.

scientific_limitations: The result computes Euler characteristic only; it does not determine Betti numbers, intersection cohomology, singularities, components, or motives.
The theorem concerns the complex projective matrix variety, not the real symmetric or Hermitian loci studied in related topology literature.
The localization argument is short after the diagonal equality-partition stratification is isolated, so an unindexed or folklore observation remains possible.
title: Euler characteristics of the subdiscriminant filtration of projective matrix space
